notes.title: Letters from the War - Patch 3
notes.content: Hey everyone! Thank you for playing the game and for sharing your valuable feedback. This is our biggest patch so far, and we’ve implemented some exciting new features. There is a new section in the censor UI with the protagonist's notes, where you can learn more about his tasks and his thoughts about them. We have enhanced the text and balanced the letter-censoring mechanics so that you can no longer censor everything and hop the wag. We fixed minor bugs and worked more on the sound design. We hope you will enjoy these new features!
